pa.cau: Kết luận
pa.ipa_noi: /keɪ tiː luː en/

luot.en: Do you enjoy studying?

pa.cau: Do you enjoy studying?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈstʌdiːɪŋ/

luot.en: Yes, I do, although it depends on the subject. I really enjoy languages because I can use them immediately, whereas I find maths quite difficult.

pa.cau: Yes, I do, although it depends on the subject. I really enjoy languages because I can use them immediately, whereas I find maths quite difficult.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes‿aɪ də ˌɔːˈlðəʊ ɪt dɪˈpendz‿ɑːn ðə ˈsʌbdʒɪkt‿aɪ ˈrɪliː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈlæŋɡwədʒəz bɪˈkɔːz‿aɪ kən‿juːs ðəm ˌɪˈmiːˌdiːətliː weˈræz‿aɪ faɪnd maths kwaɪt ˈdɪfəkəlt/

luot.en: What was your favourite subject at school?

pa.cau: What was your favourite subject at school?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt‿wəz‿jə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈsʌbdʒɪkt‿ət skuːl/

luot.en: Probably literature. My teacher was excellent at encouraging critical thinking rather than rote learning, which was quite rare in my school.

pa.cau: Probably literature. My teacher was excellent at encouraging critical thinking rather than rote learning, which was quite rare in my school.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈprɑːbəˌbliː ˈlɪtərətʃə maɪ ˈtiːtʃə wəz ˈeksələnt‿ət‿eˈnkɜːrɪdʒɪŋ ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ˈræðə ðən rəʊt ˈlɜːnɪŋ‿wɪtʃ‿wəz kwaɪt reə ɪn maɪ skuːl/

luot.en: Do you think exams are a good way to test students?

pa.cau: Do you think exams are a good way to test students?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə θɪŋk‿ɪˈɡzæmz‿ə ə ɡʊd‿weɪ tə test ˈstuːdənts/

luot.en: Not entirely. They measure memory well, but they don’t really show whether someone can apply knowledge in real situations.

pa.cau: Not entirely. They measure memory well, but they don’t really show whether someone can apply knowledge in real situations.
pa.ipa_noi: /nɑːt‿ɪˈntaɪəliː ðeɪ ˈmeʒə ˈmeməriː wel bət ðeɪ dɑːn tiː ˈrɪliː ʃəʊ ˈweðə ˈsʌˌmwʌn kən‿əˈplaɪ ˈnɑːlədʒ‿ɪn riːl ˌsɪtʃuːˈeɪʃənz/

luot.en: How important is a university degree these days?
luot.vi: Ngày nay tấm bằng đại học quan trọng đến mức nào?

pa.cau: How important is a university degree these days?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ ˌɪˈmpɔːtənt‿ɪz‿ə ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiː dɪˈɡriː ðiːz deɪz/

luot.en: It still matters in many fields, particularly medicine and law. However, in areas such as design or software, employers increasingly look at what you can actually do.
luot.vi: Ở nhiều ngành nó vẫn quan trọng, nhất là y và luật. Tuy nhiên, trong các lĩnh vực như thiết kế hay phần mềm, nhà tuyển dụng ngày càng nhìn vào năng lực thực tế.

pa.cau: It still matters in many fields, particularly medicine and law. However, in areas such as design or software, employers increasingly look at what you can actually do.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt stɪl ˈmætəz‿ɪn ˈmeniː fiːldz ˌpɑːˈtɪkjələliː ˈmedsn‿ən lɔː ˌhaʊˈevə ɪn ˈeriːəz sʌtʃ‿əz dɪˈzaɪn‿ɔː ˈsɒftweə eˈmplɔɪəz‿ɪˈnkriːsɪŋliː lʊk‿ət‿wʌ‿tʃə kən ˈæˌktʃuːəliː duː/

luot.en: Should students choose subjects they enjoy or subjects with good job prospects?
luot.vi: Sinh viên nên chọn ngành mình thích hay ngành dễ xin việc?

pa.cau: Should students choose subjects they enjoy or subjects with good job prospects?
pa.ipa_noi: /ʃəd ˈstuːdənts tʃuːz ˈsʌbdʒɪkts ðeɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ɔː ˈsʌbdʒɪkts‿wɪð ɡʊd dʒɒb ˈprɑːspekts/

luot.en: Ideally both, although that is not always possible. In my view, interest matters more in the long run, because people who enjoy their subject tend to keep learning after graduation.
luot.vi: Lý tưởng là cả hai, dù không phải lúc nào cũng được. Theo tôi, về lâu dài sự hứng thú quan trọng hơn, vì người thích ngành học thường tiếp tục học sau khi ra trường.

pa.cau: Ideally both, although that is not always possible. In my view, interest matters more in the long run, because people who enjoy their subject tend to keep learning after graduation.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪˈdiːliː bəʊθ ˌɔːˈlðəʊ ðət‿ɪz nɑːt ˈɔːˌlweɪz ˈpɑːsəbəl‿ɪn maɪ vjuː ˈɪntrəst ˈmætəz mɔː ɪn ðə lɔːŋ rʌn bɪˈkɔːz ˈpiːpəl huː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ðeə ˈsʌbdʒɪkt tend tə kiːp ˈlɜːnɪŋ ˈæftə ˌɡrædʒuːˈeɪʃən/

luot.en: What is the main difference between studying at school and at university?
luot.vi: Khác biệt chính giữa học phổ thông và học đại học là gì?

pa.cau: What is the main difference between studying at school and at university?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt‿ɪz ðə meɪn ˈdɪfərəns bɪˈtwiːn ˈstʌdiːɪŋ‿ət skuːl‿ən‿ət ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiː/

luot.en: At school you are told what to learn, whereas at university you have to organise your own time. As a result, many first-year students struggle at first.
luot.vi: Ở phổ thông bạn được chỉ định học gì, trong khi ở đại học bạn phải tự sắp xếp thời gian. Vì vậy, nhiều sinh viên năm nhất ban đầu khá chật vật.

pa.cau: At school you are told what to learn, whereas at university you have to organise your own time. As a result, many first-year students struggle at first.
pa.ipa_noi: /ət skuːl‿jə ə təʊld‿wʌt tə lɜːn‿weˈræz‿ət ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiː jə həv tə organise jə əʊn taɪm‿əz‿ə rɪˈzʌlt ˈmeniː fɜːs‿tʃɪə ˈstuːdənts ˈstrʌɡəl‿ət fɜːst/

luot.en: Do you think online courses will replace classrooms?
luot.vi: Bạn có nghĩ các khóa học trực tuyến sẽ thay thế lớp học không?

pa.cau: Do you think online courses will replace classrooms?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə θɪŋk ˈɔːˌnlaɪn ˈkɔːsəz l rɪˈpleɪs ˈklæˌsruːmz/

luot.en: Not completely. They are convenient and far cheaper, but they cannot easily reproduce discussion or laboratory work, which is where much of the learning happens.
luot.vi: Không hoàn toàn. Chúng tiện lợi và rẻ hơn nhiều, nhưng khó tái tạo được thảo luận hay thực hành phòng thí nghiệm — nơi phần lớn việc học thực sự diễn ra.

pa.cau: Not completely. They are convenient and far cheaper, but they cannot easily reproduce discussion or laboratory work, which is where much of the learning happens.
pa.ipa_noi: /nɑːt kəˈmpliːtliː ðeɪ ə kəˈnviːnjənt‿ən fɑː ˈtʃiːpə bət ðeɪ ˈkænɑːt ˈiːzəliː ˌriːprəˈduːs dɪˈskʌʃən‿ɔː ˈlæbrəˌtɔːriː wɜːk‿wɪtʃ‿ɪz‿weə mʌtʃ‿əv ðə ˈlɜːnɪŋ ˈhæpənz/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại 2 — Bàn về học phí và cơ hội

luot.en: Should higher education be free?
luot.vi: Giáo dục đại học có nên miễn phí không?

pa.cau: Should higher education be free?
pa.ipa_noi: /ʃəd ˈhaɪə ˌedʒəˈkeɪʃən biː friː/

luot.en: In principle I support it, since it widens access. On the other hand, someone has to pay, and higher taxes are not always popular.
luot.vi: Về nguyên tắc tôi ủng hộ, vì nó mở rộng cơ hội tiếp cận. Mặt khác, ai đó vẫn phải trả tiền, và tăng thuế thì không phải lúc nào cũng được ủng hộ.

pa.cau: In principle I support it, since it widens access. On the other hand, someone has to pay, and higher taxes are not always popular.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪn ˈprɪnsəpəl‿aɪ səˈpɔːt‿ɪt sɪns‿ɪt ˈwaɪdənz ˈæˌkses‿ɑːn ðə ˈʌðə hænd ˈsʌˌmwʌn həz tə peɪ ən ˈhaɪə ˈtæksəz‿ə nɑːt ˈɔːˌlweɪz ˈpɑːpjələ/

luot.en: Who benefits most from a free system?
luot.vi: Ai hưởng lợi nhiều nhất từ hệ thống miễn phí?

pa.cau: Who benefits most from a free system?
pa.ipa_noi: /huː ˈbenəfɪts məʊst frəm‿ə friː ˈsɪstəm/

luot.en: Students from low-income families, obviously. Nevertheless, evidence suggests that middle-class families often benefit more, because their children are better prepared for entrance exams.
luot.vi: Rõ ràng là sinh viên gia đình thu nhập thấp. Tuy nhiên, bằng chứng cho thấy gia đình trung lưu thường hưởng lợi hơn, vì con họ được chuẩn bị tốt hơn cho kỳ thi đầu vào.

pa.cau: Students from low-income families, obviously. Nevertheless, evidence suggests that middle-class families often benefit more, because their children are better prepared for entrance exams.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈstuːdənts frəm ləʊ ˈɪˌnkʌm ˈfæməliːz ˈɑːbviːəsliː ˌnevəðəˈles ˈevədəns səˈdʒests ðət ˈmɪdəl klæs ˈfæməliːz ˈɔːfən ˈbenəfɪt mɔː bɪˈkɔːz ðeə ˈtʃɪldrən‿ə ˈbetə priːˈpeəd fə ˈentrəns‿ɪˈɡzæmz/

luot.en: How could universities support poorer students?
luot.vi: Các trường có thể hỗ trợ sinh viên nghèo bằng cách nào?

pa.cau: How could universities support poorer students?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ kəd ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiːz səˈpɔːt ˈpuːrə ˈstuːdənts/

luot.en: Through scholarships and paid internships. Moreover, providing affordable accommodation would remove one of the biggest costs.
luot.vi: Bằng học bổng và thực tập có lương. Hơn nữa, cung cấp chỗ ở giá rẻ sẽ loại bỏ một trong những khoản tốn kém nhất.

pa.cau: Through scholarships and paid internships. Moreover, providing affordable accommodation would remove one of the biggest costs.
pa.ipa_noi: /θruː ˈskɑːləˌʃɪps‿ən peɪd ˈɪntəˌnʃɪps mɔːˈrəʊvə prəˈvaɪdɪŋ‿əˈfɔːdəbəl‿əˌkɒməˈdeɪʃn‿wəd riːˈmuːv‿wʌn‿əv ðə ˈbɪɡəst kɑːsts/

luot.en: Is it fair that graduates earn more than non-graduates?
luot.vi: Việc người có bằng kiếm nhiều hơn người không có bằng có công bằng không?

pa.cau: Is it fair that graduates earn more than non-graduates?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz‿ɪt feə ðət ˈɡrædʒəwəts ɜːn mɔː ðən nɑːn ˈɡrædʒəwəts/

luot.en: It is understandable, given the time and money they invest. Even so, many skilled workers are underpaid, which I think is harder to justify.
luot.vi: Điều đó dễ hiểu, xét về thời gian và tiền bạc họ bỏ ra. Dù vậy, nhiều lao động tay nghề cao vẫn bị trả lương thấp, và theo tôi điều đó khó biện minh hơn.

pa.cau: It is understandable, given the time and money they invest. Even so, many skilled workers are underpaid, which I think is harder to justify.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz ˌʌndəˈstændəbəl ˈɡɪvən ðə taɪm‿ən ˈmʌni ðeɪ ɪnˈvest ˈiːvɪn səʊ ˈmeniː skɪld ˈwɜːkəz‿ə ˈʌndəˈpeɪd‿wɪtʃ‿aɪ θɪŋk‿ɪz ˈhɑːdə tə ˈdʒʌstəˌfaɪ/

luot.en: Will this gap grow in the future?
luot.vi: Khoảng cách này sẽ tăng lên trong tương lai chứ?

pa.cau: Will this gap grow in the future?
pa.ipa_noi: /l ðɪs ɡæp ɡrəʊ ɪn ðə ˈfjuːtʃə/

luot.en: It may narrow, actually. As automation replaces routine office tasks, practical skills could become relatively more valuable.
luot.vi: Thực ra nó có thể thu hẹp lại. Khi tự động hóa thay thế các công việc văn phòng lặp lại, kỹ năng thực hành có thể trở nên có giá hơn.

pa.cau: It may narrow, actually. As automation replaces routine office tasks, practical skills could become relatively more valuable.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt meɪ ˈnerəʊ ˈæˌktʃuːəliː əz ˌɔːtəˈmeɪʃn rɪˈpleɪsɪz ruːˈtiːn ˈɒfɪs tæsks ˈpræktəkəl skɪlz kəd bɪˈkʌm ˈrelətɪvliː mɔː ˈvæljəbəl/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại — Chọn trường đại học

luot.en: Nam, are you looking at the university website?
luot.vi: Nam ơi, cậu đang xem trang web trường đại học à?

pa.cau: Nam, are you looking at the university website?
pa.ipa_noi: /næm‿ə jə ˈlʊkɪŋ‿ət ðə ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiː ˈweˌbsaɪt/

luot.en: Yes, I am checking the academic curriculum today.
luot.vi: Ừ, tớ đang kiểm tra chương trình học thuật hôm nay.

pa.cau: Yes, I am checking the academic curriculum today.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes‿aɪ əm ˈtʃekɪŋ ðə ˌækəˈdemɪk kəˈrɪkjələm təˈdeɪ/

luot.en: Is the tuition fee high at this school?
luot.vi: Học phí ở trường này có cao không?

pa.cau: Is the tuition fee high at this school?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz ðə tjuːˈɪʃən fiː haɪ ət ðɪs skuːl/

luot.en: It is quite expensive, but I need a scholarship.
luot.vi: Nó khá đắt, nhưng tớ cần một suất học bổng.

pa.cau: It is quite expensive, but I need a scholarship.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz kwaɪt‿ɪkˈspensɪv bət‿aɪ niːd‿ə ˈskɒləʃɪp/

luot.en: Do you want a vocational course or a degree?
luot.vi: Cậu muốn học khóa nghề hay lấy bằng đại học?

pa.cau: Do you want a vocational course or a degree?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə wɑːnt‿ə vəʊˈkeɪʃənl kɔːs‿ɔː ə dɪˈɡriː/

luot.en: I want a qualification for my future career.
luot.vi: Tớ muốn có bằng cấp cho sự nghiệp tương lai.

pa.cau: I want a qualification for my future career.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ wɑːnt‿ə ˌkwɒlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn fə maɪ ˈfjuːtʃə kəˈrɪə/

luot.en: Is school attendance compulsory for everyone?
luot.vi: Đi học có bắt buộc với mọi người không?

pa.cau: Is school attendance compulsory for everyone?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz skuːl‿əˈtendəns kəmˈpʌlsəri fə ˈevriːˌwʌn/

luot.en: Yes, discipline is very important here.
luot.vi: Có chứ, kỷ luật rất quan trọng ở đây.

pa.cau: Yes, discipline is very important here.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes ˈdɪsəplɪn‿ɪz ˈveriː ˌɪˈmpɔːtənt hɪə/

luot.en: Are classes overcrowded in that school?
luot.vi: Các lớp học ở đó có bị quá tải không?

pa.cau: Are classes overcrowded in that school?
pa.ipa_noi: /ə ˈklæsəz ˈəʊvəˌkraʊdɪd‿ɪn ðət skuːl/

luot.en: They are, so students often face rote learning.
luot.vi: Có đấy, nên sinh viên thường phải học vẹt.

pa.cau: They are, so students often face rote learning.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðeɪ ə səʊ ˈstuːdənts ˈɔːfən feɪs rəʊt ˈlɜːnɪŋ/

luot.en: That sounds bad for your critical thinking.
luot.vi: Điều đó nghe có vẻ không tốt cho tư duy phản biện.

pa.cau: That sounds bad for your critical thinking.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət saʊndz bæd fə jə ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/

luot.en: I agree, I need a better way to study.
luot.vi: Tớ đồng ý, tớ cần cách học tốt hơn.

pa.cau: I agree, I need a better way to study.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ əˈɡriː aɪ niːd‿ə ˈbetə weɪ tə ˈstʌdiː/

luot.en: What helps to motivate you every day?
luot.vi: Điều gì giúp tạo động lực cho cậu mỗi ngày?

pa.cau: What helps to motivate you every day?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt helps tə ˈməʊtɪveɪ‿tʃə ˈevəriː deɪ/

luot.en: The goal of lifelong learning keeps me going.
luot.vi: Mục tiêu học tập suốt đời giữ cho tớ cố gắng.

pa.cau: The goal of lifelong learning keeps me going.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðə ɡəʊl‿əv ˈlaɪˈflɔːŋ ˈlɜːnɪŋ kiːps miː ˈɡəʊɪŋ/

luot.en: That is a great mindset for a student.
luot.vi: Đó là tư duy tuyệt vời cho một sinh viên.

pa.cau: That is a great mindset for a student.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət‿ɪz‿ə ɡreɪt ˈmaɪˌndset fə ə ˈstjuːdnt/

luot.en: I hope I find a good path soon.
luot.vi: Tớ hy vọng sớm tìm được con đường tốt.

pa.cau: I hope I find a good path soon.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ həʊp‿aɪ faɪnd‿ə ɡʊd pæθ suːn/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại — Bàn về bỏ học

luot.en: Lan, why are you worried about the dropout rate?
luot.vi: Lan, sao cậu lại lo lắng về tỷ lệ bỏ học thế?

pa.cau: Lan, why are you worried about the dropout rate?
pa.ipa_noi: /læn‿waɪ ə jə ˈwɜːriːd‿əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdrɑːˌpaʊt reɪt/

luot.en: My cousin wants to stop his school now.
luot.vi: Anh họ tớ muốn dừng việc học ngay bây giờ.

pa.cau: My cousin wants to stop his school now.
pa.ipa_noi: /maɪ ˈkʌzn‿wɑːnts tə stɒp hɪz skuːl naʊ/

luot.en: Is his school curriculum too difficult for him?

> **Đề:** Some people believe university education should be free for everyone. Do you agree or disagree?

> Firstly, free university education would give students from low-income families a fair chance to succeed. Consequently, many students struggle to stay engaged, leading to a high dropout rate in some regions. Firstly, traditional schooling frequently fails to motivate learners because it ignores individual interests in favor of standardized testing. Secondly, the financial burden of high tuition fees makes higher education inaccessible for many, regardless of their potential for lifelong learning. Nam sits at his desk at home reviewing his notes while feeling overwhelmed by these systemic barriers. He contemplates the importance of acquiring a practical vocational qualification to escape this cycle. Suddenly, he decides to stop worrying about formal degrees and begins researching alternative online certifications. This simple shift in perspective transforms his gloomy afternoon into a moment of genuine excitement. He feels empowered because he finally prioritizes his own path toward skill acquisition.

phat_am:
- **curriculum** /kəˈrɪkjələm/ — trọng âm âm thứ 2.
- **qualification** /ˌkwɒlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ — trọng âm rơi vào **-CA-** (âm thứ 4).
- Quy tắc vàng: **danh từ tận cùng -tion / -sion luôn nhấn ngay trước đuôi**: educaTION, moTIvation, deCIsion.
luu_y:
**① Although / Despite — cấu trúc khác nhau, nhầm là mất điểm ngữ pháp:**

- **Although / Even though / Though** + **mệnh đề** (S + V): *Although it **was** expensive, I bought it.*
- **Despite / In spite of** + **danh từ / V-ing**: *Despite the **cost**, I bought it.* / *Despite **being** expensive…*
- ❌ Despite it was expensive… → ✅ Despite the fact **that** it was expensive…

**② because vs because of:**

- **because** + mệnh đề: because the fees are high
- **because of / due to** + danh từ: because of the high fees

**③ Không dùng “But” hoặc “And” đầu câu trong văn viết học thuật.** Dùng **However,** và **Moreover,** thay thế.

**④ However phải có dấu phẩy và đứng đầu câu mới**, không nối 2 mệnh đề như “but”:

- ❌ It is expensive, however I bought it.
- ✅ It is expensive. **However,** I bought it. / It is expensive; **however,** I bought it.

**⑤ Đừng nhồi từ nối.** Band 5 thường mắc lỗi dùng “Moreover, Furthermore, In addition” liên tiếp trong 3 câu. Một đoạn 5 câu chỉ cần 2–3 từ nối.

**⑥ such as + ví dụ cụ thể, không đi với “and so on”:**
✅ subjects such as maths and physics · ❌ such as maths, physics and so on
meo:
- **Although đi với câu, Despite đi với chữ.** (“chữ” = danh từ/V-ing)
- Nhớ trọng âm bằng 3 quy tắc phủ được ~70% từ học thuật: **-tion/-sion → nhấn trước đuôi · -ity → nhấn trước đuôi (uniVERsity) · -ic → nhấn trước đuôi (acaDEmic)**.
- Học từ vựng theo **collocation**, không học từ đơn. “tuition fees” luôn đi với *rising / afford / pay* — nhớ cả cụm thì viết nhanh gấp đôi.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Giáo dục và từ nối
mini_story.truyen: Academic education often relies on a rigid curriculum that prioritizes rote learning over critical thinking. Consequently, many students struggle to stay engaged, leading to a high dropout rate in some regions. Firstly, traditional schooling frequently fails to motivate learners because it ignores individual interests in favor of standardized testing. Secondly, the financial burden of high tuition fees makes higher education inaccessible for many, regardless of their potential for lifelong learning. Nam sits at his desk at home reviewing his notes while feeling overwhelmed by these systemic barriers. He contemplates the importance of acquiring a practical vocational qualification to escape this cycle. Suddenly, he decides to stop worrying about formal degrees and begins researching alternative online certifications. This simple shift in perspective transforms his gloomy afternoon into a moment of genuine excitement. He feels empowered because he finally prioritizes his own path toward skill acquisition.

mini_story.truyen: Many people argue that the traditional academic curriculum fails to prepare students for the modern workforce. Firstly, an over-reliance on rote learning often discourages critical thinking among students. Consequently, many learners struggle to apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios. Secondly, the rising cost of tuition fees combined with high dropout rates suggests that the current system is becoming less accessible. For example, vocational training programmes offer a more direct route to a professional qualification than general academic paths. This shift towards practical skills does not imply that core subjects are unimportant. Instead, it highlights the necessity for a balanced approach to lifelong learning. Nam meets his colleague Tuan to discuss these pressing educational issues. Tuan initially supports the old system but soon changes his mind. He finally agrees that schools must focus on developing modern skills rather than memorisation. This transformation of perspective marks a new chapter in their professional relationship. They now start planning a workshop on student engagement.
